projects.name: LearnHub - Learning Management System
projects.tech: React.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express.js, Prisma, MySQL, Nx
points: Built a full stack LMS with role-based access for students, instructors and admins, each with a separate dashboard and protected routes, plus a public course catalog.

Structured the codebase as an Nx monorepo (pnpm) with a React web app, an Express API and a shared package of TypeScript types and Zod schemas; managed client state with Zustand and API calls through a central Axios client.
Designed a modular REST API where each module (auth, courses, enrollments, quizzes, assignments, certificates) has its own routes, controller, service and validation, using Prisma with MySQL.
Implemented course enrollment, lesson progress tracking, quizzes and assignment submission, with certificates issued automatically on assignment completion.

projects.name: Student Management System
projects.tech: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MySQL, Sequelize, Passport.js
points: Built a full stack student management app with MVC architecture and REST APIs.
Implemented register, login and logout using Passport.js session-based authentication.
Developed add, view, edit, delete and search features for student records using Sequelize ORM on a MySQL database.

projects.name: NexBuy - E-commerce Web Application
projects.tech: React.js, TypeScript, React Bootstrap, JSON Server, React Context API
points: Built an e-commerce web interface for browsing and managing products using React.js and TypeScript.
Integrated JSON Server as a mock REST backend to support full CRUD operations on products.
Centralized application state with React Context API, giving components shared data and a consistent user experience.
